anki_csv_exports.sql:
CREATE TABLE anki_csv_exports (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            exported_at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

anki_exports.sql:
CREATE TABLE anki_exports (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            exported_at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

categories.sql:
CREATE TABLE categories (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            color TEXT NOT NULL,
            position INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

curriculum_words.sql:
CREATE TABLE curriculum_words (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            standing TEXT NOT NULL,
            came TEXT NOT NULL,
            entered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            days_met INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_day TEXT,
            sittings INTEGER NOT NULL,
            retired_at TEXT
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

daily_coverage.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_coverage (
            day TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            known INTEGER NOT NULL,
            deck INTEGER NOT NULL,
            new INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

daily_exposures.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_exposures (
            day TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            count INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (day, entry_id)
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

daily_listening.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_listening (
            day TEXT NOT NULL,
            category TEXT NOT NULL,
            seconds REAL NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (day, category)
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

deck_words.sql:
CREATE TABLE deck_words (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            headword TEXT NOT NULL,
            traditional TEXT NOT NULL,
            reading TEXT NOT NULL,
            meaning TEXT NOT NULL,
            sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
            translation TEXT NOT NULL,
            learned_at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

exposures.sql:
CREATE TABLE exposures (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            heard INTEGER NOT NULL,
            heard_by_you INTEGER NOT NULL,
            heard_in_deck INTEGER NOT NULL
        , first_heard TEXT, days_heard INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_heard TEXT) WITHOUT ROWID

level.sql:
CREATE TABLE level (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
            scheme TEXT NOT NULL,
            midpoint REAL NOT NULL
        )

line_history.sql:
CREATE TABLE line_history (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            scheme TEXT,
            midpoint REAL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL,
            at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

load_words.sql:
CREATE TABLE load_words (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            standing TEXT NOT NULL,
            stage INTEGER NOT NULL,
            meetings INTEGER NOT NULL,
            by_hand INTEGER NOT NULL,
            place INTEGER,
            entered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            last_met TEXT,
            graduated_at TEXT
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

lookups.sql:
CREATE TABLE lookups (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            pinned INTEGER NOT NULL,
            hovered INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            pinned_since_known INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

saved_sentences.sql:
CREATE TABLE saved_sentences (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            original TEXT NOT NULL,
            translation TEXT NOT NULL,
            parts TEXT NOT NULL,
            translation_language TEXT NOT NULL,
            category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            saved_at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

saved_words.sql:
CREATE TABLE saved_words (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            headword TEXT NOT NULL,
            traditional TEXT NOT NULL,
            reading TEXT NOT NULL,
            meaning TEXT NOT NULL,
            category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            source_sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_translation TEXT NOT NULL,
            saved_at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

set_words.sql:
CREATE TABLE set_words (
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            sources TEXT NOT NULL,
            added_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (name, entry_id)
        ) WITHOUT ROWID

status_history.sql:
CREATE TABLE status_history (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            before TEXT NOT NULL,
            after TEXT NOT NULL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL,
            at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

statuses.sql:
CREATE TABLE statuses (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            status TEXT NOT NULL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL,
            at TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID
